title: Redact token values in a simple log format
prompt: Replace the value after every literal "token=" with "***". A value ends at the next ASCII space or the end of the string. Preserve all other characters. This is a deliberately narrow log format, not a general secret detector.

tests.label: Middle field
tests.hint: Preserve fields around the redacted value.

tests.label: At end
tests.hint: The end of the string also ends a value.

tests.label: Empty value
tests.hint: Even an empty value gets the replacement marker.

hints: Find the marker, then find the next space after it.
Replacement changes the string length, so advance using the replacement length.
explanation: The scan follows the stated field boundary rather than trying to guess secrets. Real logging should avoid emitting sensitive fields in the first place and use a structured redaction policy.
